description: Source code for a custom test reporter class 'ListReporter' used in Playwright testing framework, responsible for displaying test progress and results in terminal environments.

classes.name: ListReporter
classes.description: A terminal reporter class for displaying test execution progress and results with detailed line management and TTY support.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, optionally printing a starting message.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of an individual test, assigning an index and printing its title.

methods.name: onStdOut
methods.description: Outputs standard output chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Outputs standard error chunks during test execution.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test step, optionally printing step details.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updating the display with step duration and errors.

methods.name: _maybeWriteNewLine
methods.description: Inserts a new line if needed based on internal state.

methods.name: _updateLineCountAndNewLineFlagForOutput
methods.description: Updates internal line and column counters based on output text.

methods.name: _dumpToStdio
methods.description: Writes output chunks to the appropriate stream, respecting quiet mode.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing a test, displaying pause message and errors if any.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test, updating its display line.

methods.name: _updateTestLine
methods.description: Updates the display line for a test with its current status.

methods.name: _updateOrAppendLine
methods.description: Updates an existing line or appends a new one for a given entity.

methods.name: _appendLine
methods.description: Appends a new line to the output.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates a specific line in the output.

methods.name: _updateLineForTTY
methods.description: Updates a line in TTY mode, handling cursor movement.

methods.name: _testPrefix
methods.description: Generates a prefix string for test lines based on index and status.

methods.name: _retrySuffix
methods.description: Returns a suffix string if the test is a retry.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during test execution, printing error messages.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test suite, printing final results.
